ValidationRule.description: Created this Validation rule to mandate TCV field if contract term is above 12 in stage 4 and stage 5 #13028 #13027 #13703
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))),
$Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales_IMTN', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission),
OR( ISBLANK(Contract_Term_months__c), Contract_Term_months__c<1 ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4 - Negotiate'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in') ),
QTB_APIProcess__c = false
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a valid Contract Term(months) before moving to Stage 4 or Stage 5
